title: Identification of Markers on the Basis of Transcriptomic Analysis for Molecular Assignment of Medulloblastoma.
authors: Juarez-Mendez, Sergio; Vazquez-Jimenez, Aaron; Ramirez-Chiquito, Josselen Carina; Villegas-Ruiz, Vanessa; Niembro-Zuniga, Ana Maria; Farfan-Morales, Jose Eduardo; Marhx-Bracho, Alfonso; Krotzsch, Edgar; Rodriguez-Morales, Miguel; Segura-Solis, Emma; Perezpena-Diazconti, Mario; Ridaura-Sanz, Cecilia; Rivera-Luna, Roberto; Eguia-Aguilar, Pilar; Resendis-Antonio, Osbaldo; Melendez-Zajgla, Jorge
one_liner_zh: 基于转录组分析和无监督机器学习的髓母细胞瘤分子分型研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Medulloblastoma is a heterogeneous solid tumor, and its molecular characteristics are the most important prognostic factors for this neoplasm. Unfortunately, the molecular classification of MB-G3 and MB-G-4 medulloblastoma is very complex because of molecular similarity. Therefore, in this work, through unsupervised machine learning-based gene expression profiling, we identified a low molecular profile associated with four molecular groups of medulloblastoma. We performed medulloblastoma expression microarray data mining via the Partek Genomics Suite and Transcriptome Analysis Console (TAC), and we included a total of 25 fresh medulloblastoma tumors that were obtained and hybridized into HG U133 Plus 2.0 Array microarrays. To identify the molecular groups of the 25 patients, we compared them against classified patients, which were obtained from free repositories, and through data mining based on gene expression, compared the expression profiles of our patients. To do so, we performed an analysis via the least squares method via PCA. The molecular groups MB-WNT and MB-SHH were confirmed via immunohistochemistry via beta-catenin, YAP1 and GAB1 antibodies in tissue fixed in formalin and embedded in paraffin, and another tissue section was placed on a Visium Spatial slide to perform spatial RNA-seq via Illumina NextSeq 2000 platform sequencers. The data obtained were analyzed with R. We identified the expression profiles associated with the four molecular groups and formed a reference set. Through unsupervised analysis via the least squares method, we assigned the molecular profiles of 25 patients with medulloblastoma, via the integration of bulk and spatial tumor molecular gene expression profiling analysis and with immunohistochemical findings, this strategy was fast and accurate. We observed correlations in three of the trials carried out and, in part, in one study, a patient who presented two tumor strains and two molecular signatures (SHH and G4), which led us to believe that this patient presented mixed phenotypic characteristics. Multigene expression profile analysis of medulloblastoma represents a significant advance in precision medicine; integrating different layers of transcriptomic information allows us to demonstrate underlying molecular changes in the four molecular groups that are essential for personalized therapy.
abstract_zh: 髓母细胞瘤是一种异质性实体肿瘤，其分子特征是该肿瘤最重要的预后因素。不幸的是，由于分子相似性，MB-G3和MB-G4髓母细胞瘤的分子分型非常复杂。因此，在本研究中，通过基于无监督机器学习的基因表达谱分析，我们识别出一个与四种髓母细胞瘤分子亚组相关的低分子谱。我们利用Partek Genomics Suite和转录组分析控制台（TAC）进行了髓母细胞瘤表达微阵列数据挖掘，并纳入了总共25个新鲜髓母细胞瘤肿瘤样本，这些样本被获取并杂交到HG U133 Plus 2.0 Array微阵列上。为了确定这25名患者的分子亚组，我们将其与从免费数据库中获得的已分类患者进行比较，并通过基于基因表达的数据挖掘，比较我们患者的表达谱。为此，我们通过主成分分析（PCA）采用最小二乘法进行了分析。MB-WNT和MB-SHH分子亚组通过免疫组织化学方法，使用β-连环蛋白、YAP1和GAB1抗体在福尔马林固定和石蜡包埋的组织中得以确认，另一组织切片被放置在Visium空间载玻片上，以通过Illumina NextSeq 2000平台测序仪进行空间RNA测序。获得的数据使用R软件进行分析。我们识别了与四种分子亚组相关的表达谱，并形成了一个参考集。通过基于最小二乘法的无监督分析，我们为25名髓母细胞瘤患者分配了分子谱，通过整合批量及空间肿瘤分子基因表达谱分析与免疫组织化学发现，这一策略快速且准确。我们在三项试验中观察到相关性，并在部分研究中，一名患者呈现两种肿瘤株和两种分子特征（SHH和G4），这使我们相信该患者表现出混合表型特征。髓母细胞瘤的多基因表达谱分析代表了精准医学的重大进步；整合不同层次的转录组信息使我们能够展示四种分子亚组中潜在分子变化，这些变化对个性化治疗至关重要。
